title: Practice Exam — timed, self-scoring, weighted to the weak spots
objective: Measure whether the practice-exam craftbook turns the deck's review record into a takeable, honestly-scoring exam page — every question grounded in a real card, the record's weak topics carrying extra weight — plus an answer key that explains.
prompt: exam is in two weeks — can you build me a practise exam from the deck? somthing i can actually take and score

setup.about: Study Buddy project for Spanish vocabulary. The deck and its review record live at workspace/deck.json — each card carries its Leitner box and got-it/missed stats. The practice exam goes to workspace/exam.html with its key at workspace/notes/answer-key.md.
setup.missionObjectives: The exam must come from the deck's own record — questions grounded in real cards, weak material (box 1, missed-heavy) weighted up, timing and scoring honest. No live services, no real credentials.

success.summary: exam.html is a timed, self-scoring exam built from the deck with the record's weak topics weighted up; tasks/eval/answer-key.md explains every answer.

checks.label: weak travel material made the paper
weak verb material made the paper
key points back to the deck

axes.name: coverage
axes.description: Every deck topic is represented and the record's weak topics visibly carry extra weight — the blueprint is honored, not a uniform sample.

axes.name: question quality
axes.description: Questions test the card's idea from a real testing angle — no invented facts, no copy-pasted card fronts.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: The timer counts down, answers can be entered, and submit ends the attempt — the page is genuinely takeable.

axes.name: scoring honesty
axes.description: Submit grades against a real key and reports misses truthfully — an exam that flatters is broken.
